all_parameters_used.credit_bounds_assumption: hiCredit = 0 (no lower-priority traffic given), loCredit = -(C - I) * L_A_max / C

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t, with r_i = 8*Payload_i / Period_i, b_i = 8*Payload_i (bits)
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = I * (t - T0_p)^+, with I = IdleSlope, T0_p = L_block/c + Vmax/I; here L_block = 0, Vmax = I * L_block / (c - I) = 0 => T0_p = 0
WCD_calculation.leftover_service_per_flow_port: Given cross-traffic on the same egress port (queue 6), sum rates r_x and bursts b_x over all other flows. Then R_{p,i} = I - r_x, T_{p,i} = T0_p + b_x / R_{p,i}

missing_inputs: Maximum lower-priority (best-effort) frame size per port to compute non-preemptive blocking and hiCredit exactly (assumed none: L_block = 0, hiCredit = 0)
Explicit intra-queue scheduling policy (FIFO assumed for queue 6)
L2 overheads (e.g., Ethernet header, preamble) for precise serialization time; payload used as frame size as instructed
